body.statement:
Open question. On each constant-rank relative-interior stratum of the observed-law image of \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{face}}\), construct an explicit finite-dimensional parameterization \(p(\zeta)\), compute
\[
 S_P=\operatorname{diag}(p)^{-1}\frac{\partial p(\zeta)}{\partial\zeta^\top},
\]
identify the constrained score space \(\operatorname{col}(S_P)\), and determine for each reported direction whether
\[
 \{I-\Pi_{\operatorname{col}(S_P)}\}G_p\neq0.
\]
No restricted-model efficiency bound or attaining estimator is asserted without that parameterization, rank analysis, and projection calculation.
body.justification: This is an explicit open question, not a theorem: restricted-model efficiency requires an observed-law parameterization, its finite score Jacobian, and a constant-rank projection calculation.
body.gap: The present paper derives only the saturated multinomial canonical gradient; it does not characterize the smaller restricted Markov tangent space.
body.consumer: A future restricted-likelihood analysis must compute \(S_P\) and test the residual projection before claiming a sharper bound or an attaining estimator.

obligation.what_is_open: For every constant-rank relative-interior stratum of the observed-law image of \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{face}}\), construct a chart \(p(\zeta)\) whose differential exhausts that stratum's restricted tangent space, account for observationally equivalent latent representations, and evaluate for every reported direction \(a\) whether \(\{I-\Pi_{\operatorname{col}(S_P)}\}a^\top G_p\) is nonzero.
obligation.obstruction: The core supplies prospective symbols \(\zeta\) and \(S_P\), but it does not supply coordinates for cohort masses, type masses, initial laws, date-specific transition rows, common-kernel equalities, and support constraints. More importantly, \(\texttt{thm:active-frontier-recovery}\) leaves the allocation of date-\(1\) absorbers across latent types unidentified. The natural latent-primitive map is therefore noninjective, can have representation-dependent Jacobians, and may meet itself or change rank at boundary strata. A derivative at one latent representation is not thereby proved to span the tangent space of the observed-law image. Without an atlas or an equivalent finite system of observable equality constraints and a rank proof, \(\operatorname{col}(S_P)\) is undetermined; projecting onto a postulated space would assume the central step of the question.
obligation.attempted: A natural four-wave candidate parameterizes each legal observed cell \(p_{d,x_0,x_1,x_2,x_3}\) by cohort mass, known-\(J\) type masses, initial laws, and the \(H_j\), \(Q_j\), and \(R_j^d\) transition factors, subject to stochastic-row and common-kernel equalities. Differentiating this finite polynomial map gives a candidate Jacobian. This does not close the question: unreachable rows, label equivalences, and arbitrary type allocations among paths absorbed by date \(1\) yield nonunique primitive points above the same observed law, so the derivative at one representation has not been shown to span the tangent space of the entire observed-law stratum.
obligation.partial_result:
For any supplied \(C^1\) chart \(p(\zeta)\) on a fixed positive support \(\mathcal S_0\), let
\[
 W=\operatorname{diag}\{p_s:s\in\mathcal S_0\},\qquad
 A=\frac{\partial p(\zeta)}{\partial\zeta^\top},\qquad
 S=W^{-1}A.
\]
For a differentiable path \(\zeta_t\) through \(\zeta\), differentiation gives \(\dot p=A\dot\zeta\), so its observed-law score is \(h=W^{-1}\dot p=S\dot\zeta\).  If the chart has locally constant rank and its image is the whole chosen stratum, its score space is \(\operatorname{col}(S)\).  For any reported linear direction \(a\), put \(g_a(s)=a^\top G_p(s)\).  Weighted least squares then gives the computable projection
\[
 \Pi_{\operatorname{col}(S)}g_a
 =W^{-1}A(A^\top W^{-1}A)^\dagger A^\top g_a
\]
and the squared residual
\[
 \left\|(I-\Pi_{\operatorname{col}(S)})g_a\right\|_{L_2(P)}^2
 =g_a^\top Wg_a-(A^\top g_a)^\top
 (A^\top W^{-1}A)^\dagger(A^\top g_a).
\]
Thus the residual is nonzero exactly when the last display is positive, equivalently when \(g_a\notin\operatorname{col}(W^{-1}A)\).  This completes the projection calculation conditional on a valid full-stratum chart; construction and constant-rank certification of such a chart remain open.
